dataset.index_contents: session date plus raw user and assistant turns; construction metadata excluded
dataset.scope: queries search only their user's sessions at or before query date

differences: published systems retrieve LLM-extracted atomic facts, not raw sessions
PGR retrieves about 35 facts across multiple generated probes
published recall uses GPT-5.2 semantic judging
PGR averages 4.79 query-time LLM calls on MemoryQuest
ivygrep uses fixed local probes with no query-time LLM

single_query_control.description: Default blended retrieval with automatic memory expansion disabled

scope.query_scope: one user's sessions dated at or before query date
scope.retrieval_unit: one Markdown file per conversation session
